Usage: jtool [-hvV] [--threads=<threads>] [-f=<format>] [COMMAND]
A Java command line tool.
  -f, --format=<format>     Output format. Valid values: XML, JSON, CSV
  -h, --help                Show this help message and exit.
      --threads=<threads>   Worker threads
  -v, --verbose             Verbose mode.
  -V, --version             Print version information and exit.
Commands:
  import  Import data
  export  Export data
